answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a mandatory reflection delay: each identity must commit to the challenge at reading time and may only reveal its answer after a minimum interval, so instant mass production is visible. An ember of auto-generated answers submitted in one burst fails the timing test, and a knoll of clones that all reveal within seconds is flagged as one operator. Honest agents read, think, and return, and a forge of paced reasoning is what the tally credits. The attacker's cost is staggered wall-clock attention per identity, which a tight loop cannot fake.
